adaptation.stem: X and Y are inversely proportional. When x = 4, y = 5. What is y² when x = 3, rounded to two decimal places?
adaptation.explanation: Inverse proportion means xy is constant. Here xy = 4 × 5 = 20. At x = 3, y = 20/3, so y² = 400/9 = 44.444… . Rounded to two decimal places, this is 44.44, choice A.
